summary: Creative Realities, Inc. filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a registered public offering of 2,528,571 common shares at $3.50/share and pre-funded warrants for 900,000 shares at $3.49/warrant (exercise price $0.01). Proceeds to the company before expenses are ~$11.3M. The offering is a routine shelf takedown under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3, not a special situation. The underwriter has a 30-day option for 428,614 additional shares. There is no recommendation or advisor named. The filing is a capital raise, not a change-of-control or restructuring event.
